verdict.rationale: Mailgun publishes a public Postman workspace with organized collections covering all its APIs. That is a machine-readable, importable API description that roughly counts as an 'equivalent' format. However, probes for an OpenAPI or Swagger file at all standard paths returned 404, so no downloadable OpenAPI spec is evidenced. Missing for 10: a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec file, documentation of a spec download URL, and independent confirmation that the Postman collections are complete and current.
